descriptions.zh:
位于§Y[solar_system.GetName]§!星系中漂浮的§Y以太巨龙§!的龙鳞碎片引起了广泛关注。

这些鳞片经过清洗和精心打磨后，被制作成了引人注目的装饰品。这些传奇生物的遗骸一经上市便拍出了极高的价格，事实证明它们既令人惊叹又利润丰厚。
descriptions.en:
The drifting fragments of §YEther Drake§! scales in the §Y[solar_system.GetName]§! system have attracted significant attention.

The scales were cleaned and carefully polished before being crafted into striking ornamental pieces. Once offered on the market, these relics of a legendary creature fetched an exceptionally high price, proving very impressive and profitable.

label.zh: 渠道极不寻常，利润极其丰厚。
label.en: A fine profit from a most unusual source.

label.zh: 谁能想到传奇竟然如此赚钱？
label.en: Who knew legends could be so lucrative?

descriptions.zh:
在§Y方舟舰[Root.GetName]§!储存库的最深处，档案管理员们在被遗忘已久的库存中发现了一个密封的小箱子。里面装有一枚不起眼的微芯片，虽有记录但从未被妥善索引。如果它真的具有什么价值，大概也就不会被遗忘在储存箱里了。

这项技术已严重过时，所使用的数位格式甚至早于方舟舰载系统好几代。一些人推测，它可能源自航行初期，甚至可能追溯到我们的种族还生活在行星表面上的时代。
descriptions.en:
Deep within the §YArkship [Root.GetName]§! storage archives, archivists have uncovered a small sealed case buried among long-forgotten inventory. Inside was a single unremarkable microchip, catalogued but never properly indexed. If it had possessed any real value, it would likely not have ended up forgotten in a storage crate.

The technology was severely outdated, using data formats that predate several generations of Arkship systems. Some speculate that it may originate from the early days of the journey, perhaps even from the era when our species still lived on a planetary surface.

label.en: Attempt to recover the archived data.

descriptions.zh:
数据经恢复后，展示了一个古老的季节性庆典，它可以追溯到我们过往在行星上生活的岁月。它似乎是为了标记寒冷月份的流逝和自然的苏醒。社群成员聚集在一起，迎接温暖与光明的回归。人们点燃篝火，在参与者之间散播鲜艳的色彩。记录还描述了分享特制的甜点、共同歌舞，以及静静观赏季节中首批花朵绽放的情景。

尽管这种季节性变化在方舟号上已不复存在，但这些碎片让我们得以一窥祖先们曾经如何庆祝这一节日。
descriptions.en:
The recovered data shows an old seasonal celebration from our planetary past. It appears to have marked the passing of the colder months and the awakening of nature. Communities gathered to welcome the return of warmth and light. Bonfires were lit, bright colors were spread among participants. The records also describe the sharing of special sweets, singing and dancing together, and simply watching the first blooms of the season as they appeared.

Though such seasonal changes no longer exist aboard the Arkship, the fragments offer a small glimpse into how our ancestors once celebrated this fetsivity.

descriptions.zh:
从微芯片中恢复的条目描述了一个与年度周期交替相关的季节性庆典。它发生在一年中最黑暗的时期，那时白昼稀少，寒冷笼罩着星球的大部分地区。社区通过用灯光装饰房屋和公共场所来应对，将漫漫长夜变得明亮且富有节日气氛。人们聚集在一起交换礼物，分享异常丰盛的美食。

方舟舰上已不再有这样的冬天，这些数据展示了我们的祖先曾经如何用温暖与光亮回应最黑暗的季节。
descriptions.en:
The entry recovered from the microchip describes a seasonal celebration tied to the changing of the year's cycle. It took place during the darkest period of the year, when daylight was scarce and colder conditions dominated much of the planet. Communities responded by decorating their homes and public spaces with lights, turning the long nights into something bright and festive. People gathered to exchange gifts and share unusually rich foods.

Such winters no longer exist aboard the Arkship, the data shows how our ancestors once answered the darkest season with warmth and light.

descriptions.zh:
该条目似乎描述了曾经在我们母星上很常见的一种个人庆祝活动。记录提到，这是一个标志着个人年度生命周期更迭的时刻。在这一天，家人和朋友会聚集在一起，为该成员及其度过的岁月举杯欢庆。这一传统似乎还包括共同分享专为此活动准备的食物。

尽管方舟舰上的生活如今遵循着不同的节奏，但记录表明，我们的祖先曾经每年都会停下脚步，在众生之中为每一个独立生命的延续而庆祝。
descriptions.en:
The entry appears to describe a personal celebration once common on our homeworld. The records refer to an occasion marking the passing of an individual's yearly life cycle. On this day, family and friends would gather to celebrate the person and the years they had lived. The tradition seems to have involved sharing sustenance together specifically prepared for the event.

Though life aboard the Arkship now follows different rhythms, the records suggest that our ancestors once paused each year to celebrate the continuation of a single life among many.

descriptions.zh:
修复后的微芯片似乎揭示了标记新年度周期开始的庆祝活动。我们的祖先首先会打扫他们的居住空间。随着太阳周期更替的临近，各个社区聚集在一起，为最后的时刻进行倒计时。新周期的到来伴随着明亮的灯光、舞蹈和广泛的庆祝。参与者还会记录下对来年的个人意向，即旨在指导未来行动和改进的“决心”。

尽管方舟舰上的生活现在遵循严格监管的周期而非行星历法，但数据表明，我们的祖先曾如何以对未来的持续希望来标记时间的流逝。
descriptions.en:
The recovered microchip appears to reveal celebrations marking the beginning of a new yearly cycle. Our ancestors would first clean their living spaces. As the renewal of the sun cycle approached, communities gathered to count down the final moments. The arrival of the new cycle was greeted with bright lights, dancing, and widespread celebration. Participants also recorded personal intentions for the coming year, resolutions meant to guide their actions and improvements in the time ahead.

Though life aboard the Arkship now follows carefully regulated cycles rather than planetary calendars, the data shows how our ancestors once marked the passing of time with a continuous hope for the future.

descriptions.zh:
从微芯片中恢复的条目描述了一种以两人正式结合为中心的社会传统。根据记录，社群成员会聚集在一起，见证两人公开向彼此表达承诺。这些仪式通常涉及象征性的服饰、口头誓言，以及作为见证人出席的亲朋好友。

虽然方舟舰上的伴侣关系通常是通过行政系统记录，而非通过繁复的仪式，但档案显示，我们的祖先曾以隆重的仪式和全社群的庆祝来纪念此类结合。
descriptions.en:
The entry recovered from the microchip describes a social tradition centered on the formal union of two individuals. According to the records, communities gathered to witness the pair publicly declare their commitment to one another. These ceremonies often involved symbolic clothing, spoken vows, and the presence of family and friends acting as witnesses.

 While partnerships aboard the Arkship are often recorded through administrative systems rather than elaborate rituals, the archive suggests that our ancestors once marked such unions with considerable ceremony and communal celebration.

descriptions.zh:
从微芯片中恢复的记录描述了曾在家园行星上庆祝的一个热闹节日。参与者身着精致的服饰并佩戴面具，在庆典期间暂时换上新的身份。数据中还提到了有组织的游行，装饰华丽的平台在公共空间缓缓移动，人群则跟随其后，载歌载舞。

相比之下，方舟舰上的庆祝活动要克制得多，受限于值勤周期和有限的资源。记录表明，在另一个时代，我们的祖先偶尔会抛开实用主义，转而追求场面与纵情。
descriptions.en:
The record recovered from the microchip describes a lively festival once celebrated on our homeworld. Participants dressed in elaborate costumes and masks, temporarily adopting new identities for the celebration. The data also references organized processions, decorated platforms moving through public spaces while crowds followed while dancing and cheering.

Celebrations aboard the Arkship are far more restrained by comparison, shaped by duty cycles and limited resources. The records suggest that, in another time, our ancestors occasionally set practicality aside in favor of spectacle and indulgence.

descriptions.zh:
这枚微芯片揭示了一项来自我们物种行星时代的季节性节日记录。它似乎是在收获季节结束时举行的，当时各个社群聚集在一起，为一年中采集到的食物表达感激之情。这场庆典也标志着一年中阴暗时期的临近，届时白昼将变得稀缺，寒冷的气候亦会回归。参与者们身着令人不安的伪装，或许是为了模仿或驱散想象中的灵体。

尽管方舟号的农业周期经过精心调节，我们也不再需要这些传统，但档案表明，我们的祖先曾以感恩、创意和一丝顽皮来纪念季节的更迭。
descriptions.en:
The microchip revealed the record of a seasonal festival from our species' planetary era. It appears to have been held at the end of the harvesting season, when communities gathered to give thanks for the food collected during the year. The celebration also marked the approach of a darker time of year, when daylight would grow scarce and colder conditions returned. Participants dressed in unsettling disguises, perhaps to imitate or ward off imagined spirits.

Though the Arkship's agricultural cycles are carefully regulated, and we do not have any need for these traditions, the archive suggests that our ancestors once marked the changing seasons with gratitude, creativity, and a touch of mischief.

descriptions.zh:
微芯片揭示了一份文化记录。它展示了一种以缅怀逝者为中心的传统。根据数据显示，社群会为去世的亲友设立小型展示台，并用鲜花、食物以及与逝者相关的个人物品进行装饰。这种场合并非在沉默中哀悼，而似乎既有反思，又带有庆祝的色彩。

虽然方舟舰上的世代表更迭已经改变了我们纪念死者的方式，但记录表明，我们的祖先曾经不仅拨出时间来悲伤，也用来庆祝那些塑造了生者的生命。
descriptions.en:
The microchip revealed a cultural record. It showed a tradition centered on remembering those who had passed away. According to the data, communities would create small displays dedicated to deceased relatives and friends, decorating them with flowers, food, and personal items connected to the departed. Rather than mourning in silence, the occasion appears to have been both reflective and celebratory.

Though generations aboard the Arkship have changed how we remember the dead, the records suggest that our ancestors once set aside time to grieve, but also to celebrate the lives that shaped those who remained.

descriptions.zh:
从微芯片中恢复的记录展示了我们的祖先曾举行的一种繁育仪式。那是一场向社区展示首窝卵的聚会。在家族成员和见证者的注视下，卵被小心地放置在准备好的筑巢空间内。仪式使用了装饰性的筑巢材料和具有象征意义的贝壳排列，并举行公共宴会以庆祝血脉的延续。

值得注意的是，记录表明这些产卵仪式曾经持续数周，涉及漫长的仪式和准备工作。相比之下，方舟舰上的此类事务处理得既迅速又私密，如今只需花费几个小时进行精心管理的流程即可完成。
descriptions.en:
The entry recovered from the microchip shows of a reproductive ceremony once practiced by our ancestors. It was a gathering during which the first clutch of eggs was presented to the community. The eggs were carefully placed within prepared nesting spaces while family members and witnesses observed. Decorative nesting materials were used as well as a symbolic arrangements of shells, and communal feasts celebrating the continuation of the lineage.

Notably, the records indicate that these egg-laying ceremonies once lasted weeks, involving extended rituals and preparations. By comparison, such matters aboard the Arkship are handled quickly and privately, nowadays it occupies little more than a few hours of carefully managed procedure.

descriptions.zh:
从微芯片中恢复的记录描述了我们的祖先在繁茂生长期延续的一种公社传统。记录中提到，人们会在茂密的树丛中聚集，培育奇特而鲜艳的果实植物，各群体之间会互相走访，观摩那些格外引人注目的生长成果。不同品种被排列在一起，构成了色彩、质感与气味交织出的复杂而生动的图案。为了在聚会期间促成稀有或奇特的花朵绽放，祖先们还会刻意改变湿度、养分和光照。

方舟舰上的生活几乎没有空间进行这种自发的耕作。如今，生长周期由农业系统严格监管，大多数菌株的优化目标是效率而非表达。
descriptions.en:
The record recovered from the microchip describes a communal tradition practiced by our ancestors during periods of abundant growth. The records refer to gatherings in dense groves where individuals would cultivate unusual and vibrant fruiting plants with colonies visiting one another to observe particularly impressive growths. Different strains were arranged together to create elaborate living patterns of color, texture, and scent. Our ancestors would deliberately alter humidity, nutrients, and light to encourage rare or unusual blooms during the gathering.

Life aboard the Arkship leaves little room for such spontaneous cultivation. Growth cycles are now carefully regulated by agricultural systems, and most fungal strains are optimized for efficiency rather than expression.

descriptions.zh:
回收的记录描述了我们祖先传承的一项古老传统。档案中记载，人们会聚集在受控的活火坑周围，刻意将自己暴露在酷热之中，以此展示韧性与生命力。参与者将火焰塑造成复杂的图案，并向其中添加稀有气体和燃料，使火焰呈现出异乎寻常的色彩。随着火势升高，观察者们会吟唱并欢庆，将这一盛事视作奇观与集体仪式。

在方舟舰上，明火受到严格管控，因为它们会对基础设施造成高度风险。
descriptions.en:
The recovered records describe an ancient tradition practiced by our ancestors. The archive describes gatherings around controlled pits of living flame, where individuals would deliberately expose themselves to intense heat as a demonstration of resilience and vitality. Participants shaped the flames into elaborate patterns, feeding them with rare gasses and fuels that caused the fire to burn in unusual colors. Observers would chant and celebrate as the flames rose higher, marking the event as both spectacle and communal ritual.

Aboard the Arkship, open flame is strictly regulated as they cause a high risk to infrastructure.

descriptions.zh:
修复后的记录描述了一项围绕后代早期成长的传统。根据记载，当幼小的个体在巢穴外迈出独立的第一步时，家人们会聚集在一起。那一时刻似乎被视为一个微小但具有意义的里程碑，人们通常会通过鼓励、分享食物以诱导幼崽走出巢穴，以及亲友们的关注来予以庆祝。

在方舟舰上的生活，极少允许为个人里程碑举行此类聚会。
descriptions.en:
The recovered entry describes a tradition centered on the early development of our offspring. According to the records, families would gather when a young individual took their first independent steps outside the den. The moment appears to have been treated as a small but meaningful milestone, often celebrated with encouragement, shared food to coax the young ones out, and the attention of relatives and friends.

Life aboard the Arkship rarely allows for such gatherings around individual milestones.

descriptions.zh:
从微芯片中恢复的记录描述了一项与我们祖先生命周期中的自然阶段紧密相连的传统。记录显示，在个体脱落旧外骨骼期间，人们会举行集体聚会。这些蜕皮阶段并非在隔离中进行，而是通常以仪式作为标志，旧皮有时会被装饰或保存，作为成长与新生的象征。一旦旧壳脱落，新形成的外骨骼便会被自豪地展示出来。

在方舟号上，蜕皮周期通常在受控的生物设施中管理，以确保安全与效率，并配备工作人员以应对任何可能出现的并发症。
descriptions.en:
The recovered entry from the microchip describes a tradition tied to a natural stage in the life cycle of our ancestors. They show communal gatherings during periods when individuals shed their old exoskeletons. Rather than occurring in isolation, these molting phases were often marked by ceremony and the old skin was sometimes decorated or preserved as symbols of growth and renewal. Once the old shells were shed, the newly formed exoskeletons were displayed with pride.

Aboard the Arkship, molting cycles are typically managed in controlled biological facilities to ensure safety and efficiency with staff to help if any possible complications occur.

descriptions.zh:
这段恢复的记录描述了我们的祖先在大气高度饱和时期所信奉的一种传统。人们会聚集在特备区域，刻意将体内积聚的气体和化学副产品释放到周围环境中。参与者们会相互竞争，看谁能产生最绚丽或最奇特的化学烟羽。由此产生的云雾在空气中形成了变幻莫测的色彩和反应图案。旁观者们兴致勃勃地观赏，而那些气味最刺鼻的气体往往会引起围观人群的阵阵笑声。

如今在方舟舰上，大气系统严格监管此类排放，以维持安全的环境条件。
descriptions.en:
The recovered record describes a tradition practiced by our ancestors during periods of heavy atmospheric saturation. Individuals would gather in specially prepared areas to deliberately release built-up gases and chemical byproducts into the surrounding environment. Participants would compete to produce the most vibrant or unusual chemical plumes. The resulting clouds created shifting colors and reactive patterns in the air. Spectators observed with great enthusiasm, while the most pungent gases often provoked laughter among the gathered crowd.

Nowadays aboard the Arkship, atmospheric systems strictly regulate such emissions to maintain safe environmental conditions.

descriptions.zh:
恢复的记录描述了我们祖先曾践行的一种充满活力的传统。根据记载，成群的人会聚集在开阔的岩石地带，进行有组织的掷石决斗。参与者互相投掷松散的石块，试图从对手的外层击碎或削下碎片。在冲突中掉落的小碎片有时会被收集起来作为纪念品，象征着韧性与友好的竞争。

在方舟舰上，此类活动显然会对基础设施构成威胁。船体完整性协议严禁投掷石块，这些竞赛早已从日常生活中消失。
descriptions.en:
The recovered entry describes an energetic tradition practiced by our ancestors. According to the records, large groups would gather in open rocky fields to engage in organized stone fights. Participants hurled loose rocks at one another while attempting to crack or chip pieces from their opponents' outer layers. Small fragments broken off during the clashes were sometimes collected as keepsakes, symbols of resilience and friendly rivalry.

Aboard the Arkship, such activities would pose an obvious risk to infrastructure. Hull integrity protocols strongly discourage the throwing of rocks, and these contests have long since disappeared from daily life.

descriptions.zh:
回收的微芯片描述了我们的水生祖先在母星深海中延续的一种传统。个体们会聚集在一起，共同潜入比平时栖息地更深的水域。这些潜水活动既是挑战也是庆典。深水区存在着奇异的地质结构和陌生、甚至危险的生命形式，使下潜过程充满了刺激与危险。那些抵达最深处的人往往会受到众人的钦佩。

方舟舰上的水生生境受到严格监管，深度因工程限制而受限。古老海洋那巨大的压力和无尽的黑暗已无法再亲身体验。
descriptions.en:
The recovered microchip describes a tradition practiced by our aquatic ancestors in the depths of their world's oceans. Individuals would gather to descend together into deeper waters than normally inhabited. These dives were both a challenge and a celebration. The deeper zones contained strange geological formations and unfamiliar, sometimes even dangerous life forms, making the descent both thrilling and dangerous. Those who reached the greatest depths were often regarded with admiration.

Water habitats on the Arkship are carefully regulated and depth is limited by engineering constraints. The vast pressures and endless darkness of the ancient oceans can no longer be experienced.

descriptions.zh:
最近的报告显示，一种侵入性真菌物种已蔓延至§Y方舟舰[Root.GetName]§!的整个水培甲板。该生物似乎在方舟舰农业系统受控的湿度和营养丰富的基质中茁壮成长，在多个生产层级形成了密集的菌丝网络。

遏制措施已被证明无效，因为该真菌对标准的除草处理没有产生可测量的反应。我们怀疑该物种可能已迅速适应了飞船的封闭生态系统。如果不加以控制，此次爆发可能会显著降低粮食产量，并对方舟舰有限的农业生产能力造成额外压力。
descriptions.en:
Recent reports indicate that an invasive fungal species has spread throughout the hydroponics decks of §YArkship [Root.GetName]§!. The organism appears to thrive in the controlled humidity and nutrient-rich substrates of the arkship's agricultural systems, forming dense mycelial networks across multiple production tiers.

Containment attempts have proven ineffective, as the fungus shows no measurable reaction to standard herbicidal treatments. We suspect the species may have adapted rapidly to the enclosed ecosystem of the vessel. If left unchecked, the outbreak could significantly reduce food yields and place additional strain on the arkship's limited agricultural capacity.

label.zh: 采用破坏性手段进行净化。

descriptions.zh:
常规治理手段失效后，受污染的水培层进行了受控焚烧。不幸的是，方舟舰的大部分食用植物储备在此过程中损失殆尽。整个生长床随同感染物一起化为灰烬，导致数个农业区域暂时荒废。

尽管如此，行动似乎已达到预定目标。随着每一个带有孢子的表面都被灭菌，剩余的基础设施也经过了彻底清除，该真菌物种已从生态系统中被永久根除。这些经验将有助于我们应对未来可能在方舟舰上落户的其他外来入侵物种。
descriptions.en:
Conventional treatments having failed, the contaminated hydroponics tiers were subjected to controlled incineration. Unfortunately, much of the arkship's edible plant stock was lost in the process. Entire growth beds were reduced to ash alongside the infestation, leaving several agricultural sections temporarily barren.

Still, the operation appears to have achieved its objective. With every spore-bearing surface sterilized and the remaining infrastructure thoroughly purged, the fungal species has been eradicated from the ecosystem for good. This knowledge will help us prepare for any other invasive species that might decide to settle on the arkship in the future.

descriptions.zh:
§Y方舟舰[Root.GetName]§!上的入侵物种通过一个分布式的真菌菌丝网络运作，该网络能够迅速隔离并牺牲个体节段。每当我们尝试提取活体样本时，周围的生长物几乎会瞬间枯萎，其养分似乎通过网络被重新定向，用于保证在水耕平台的其他区域发出新芽。

在经历了多次失败的尝试后，我们终于成功分离出了一个足够稳定的样本进行受控观察。这种真菌拥有极高效率的养分再分配系统，这种系统可能适用于方舟上的闭环生态环境，甚至可能在模仿我们自己的分配系统。
descriptions.en:
The invasive species on §YArkship [Root.GetName]§! operates through a distributed mycelial network capable of rapidly isolating and sacrificing individual segments. Whenever we attempted to extract living samples, the surrounding growth would wither almost instantly, its nutrients seemingly redirected through the network to fuel new blooms elsewhere in the hydroponics decks.

After numerous failed attempts, we finally managed to isolate a sufficiently stable sample for controlled observation. The fungus possesses an extraordinarily efficient nutrient redistribution system, one that may have applications in closed ecological environments such as those aboard the arkship, perhaps even copying our own distribution systems.

descriptions.zh:
对真菌生长的进一步实验揭示了一种异常的化学反应。该生物体暴露于特定化合物时，会迅速代谢这些添加物，并释放出一种独特的混合气体副产物。我们意识到，这些气体可以被收集并提炼。

这种真菌能有效地将简单的化学输入转化为稳定的挥发性化合物流，这是一个意料之外但可能很有用的过程。通过在隔离室中培养受控的真菌生长，我们相信该生物体可以被重新利用为一个小型的生化处理系统。
descriptions.en:
Further experimentation with the fungal growth has revealed an unusual chemical reaction. When exposed to specific compounds, the organism rapidly metabolizes the additives and releases a distinct mixture of gaseous byproducts. We realized that these fumes could be harvested and refined.

The fungus effectively converts simple chemical inputs into a steady stream of volatile compounds, an unexpected but potentially useful process. By cultivated controlled fungal growth in isolated chambers, we believe that the organism could be repurposed as a small-scale biochemical processing system.

descriptions.zh:
对真菌生长的进一步观察揭示了一些规律，表明其庞大的菌丝网络内部存在某种形式的生物信号传输。对大多数物种而言，这种行为或许微不足道，但我们自身的生物特性使我们能够识别并适应这种微妙的交流。

通过引入精心校准的生化信号，我们与该生物体建立了初步的对话。从那时起，它开始通过其网络重新分配养分，并保护农作物免受有害微生物的侵害。很快我们便意识到，我们曾以为的入侵，已演变成与花园中另一种生命形式之间富有意义的共生关系。
descriptions.en:
Closer observation of the fungal growth has revealed patterns that suggest a form of biological signaling within its vast mycelial network. To most species this behavior might seem insignificant, but our own biology allows us to recognize and adapt to the subtle exchange.

By introducing carefully calibrated biochemical signals, we established a rudimentary dialogue with the organism. Since then it has begun redistributing nutrients through its networks and shielding crops from harmful microbes. Soon we realized that what we thought was an intrusion became soon a meaningful symbiosis with another lifeform sharing our gardens.

descriptions.zh:
在我们的每月库存盘点中，我们发现§Y方舟舰[Root.GetName]§!资源系统中存在持续性的偏差。电力、消费品和其他物资的损耗量小幅超过了我们的记录使用量。专家们认为这可能是泄漏、故障，或者是数据上微小的误差。

在进一步调查后，结果仍无定论。没有破口，没有故障，也没有超出可接受范围的低效。然而，数据依然如故。资源继续在毫无解释的情况下从系统中消失。方舟号上的某种东西正在消耗我们的资源。
descriptions.en:
During our monthly stock takes, we have found a persistent discrepancy in the §YArkship [Root.GetName]§! resource systems. Small amount of electricity, consumer goods, and other supplies are being taken at levels exceeding our recorded usage. Experts suggest a leak or malfunction, or a slight discrepancy in the numbers.

After investigating further, the results remain inconclusive. No breaches, no failures, no inefficiencies beyond acceptable thresholds. And yet, the numbers remain unchanged. Resources continue to vanish from the system without explanation. Something aboard the Arkship was consuming our resources.

descriptions.zh:
在方舟飞船一个无人监控的区域内，我们发现了一群生活在官方体制之外的年轻人。他们利用私自引流的电力、空气和食物，创造了自己的空间，并在不受监管的情况下进行实验、改造环境以及表达自我。

研究表明，这是青少年发育过程中的自然现象。面对调查，他们表现得十分惊讶，并带有抵触情绪。他们声称只索取了少量的资源，且行事非常谨慎，足以避开即时检测。他们明确表示，无意放弃这片空间，并希望不被打扰。
descriptions.en:
In an unmonitored section of the Arkship, we discovered a group of young individuals living outside official systems. Drawing on diverted power, air, and food, they have created their own space, experimenting, modifying their surroundings, and expressing themselves beyond supervision.

 Research suggests that it is a natural part of the development process of adolescents. They appeared genuinely surprised by the investigation and acted rebelliously. They claimed to have taken only small amounts, carefully enough to avoid immediate detection. They made it clear that they have no intention of giving up this space, and wish to be left alone.

descriptions.zh:
在一个被遗忘的维护区域，调查人员发现了一群仍在执行古老指令的过时劳工无人机。它们的日常运作似乎早于数次系统更新，导致它们在当前日志协议之外运行，且仅需极少资源即可维持运作。

进一步检查揭示了它们持续活动的成果：大量精炼合金在多个周期中被细致地加工并储存起来。这些无人机一直在悄无声息地收集并优化资源，其规模已远远超出了当前的任何运作需求。
descriptions.en:
In a forgotten maintenance sector, investigators discovered a cluster of outdated worker drones still operating under ancient directives. Their routines appear to predate several system updates, causing them to function outside current logging protocols while only requiring a small amount of resources to function.

Further inspection revealed the result of their continued activity: a substantial stockpile of refined alloys had been meticulously processed and stored over many cycles. The drones had been quietly gathering and optimizing resources far beyond any current operational requirement.

label.zh: 随他们去，但是把资源带走。
label.en: Leave them to work and take the resources

descriptions.zh:
在方舟舰一个僻静的区域，我们发现了一个在官方系统之外运行的隐秘疗养所。被挪用的电力、消费品和水资源支撑着这个专为休养和恢复而设计的受控环境。

在场的人对于被发现几乎没有表现出担忧，他们解释说，这个空间的意义在于脱离对产出和展示效率的持续关注，是从飞船日常生活中逃离的避风港。尽管方舟舰旨在满足所有需求，但仍有人在寻觅一个纯粹用于放松的地方。
descriptions.en:
In a secluded section of the Arkship, we uncovered a hidden wellness retreat operating outside official systems. Diverted power, consumer goods, and water sustain this controlled environment designed for rest and recovery.

Those present showed little concern at being discovered, explaining the space was meant to exist beyond constant need to focus on output and show off efficiency, an escape from the routines of ship life. Even though the Arkship was meant to fulfill every need, some still seek a place meant for pure relaxation.

descriptions.zh:
在方舟舰一个僻静的区域，我们发现了一个未被记录的定期聚会社体。少量被挪用的资源被用于布置这些会议场所。

成员们将这些会议描述为一种非正式的交流活动，核心是围绕方舟舰在收割作业期间收集的标本，例如从勘测星系中获取的矿物、矿石碎片和晶体结构。参与者们会检查并讨论他们的发现，比较成分并争论其起源。
descriptions.en:
In a quiet section of the Arkship, we uncovered an undocumented community gathering at regular intervals. The small amount of diverted resources had been used to accommodate these meetings.

Members described the sessions as an informal exchange centered around specimens collected during the Arkship's harvesting operations, such as minerals, ore fragments, and crystalline formations pulled from surveyed systems. Participants would examine and discuss their findings, comparing compositions and debating their origins.

descriptions.zh:
在一个密封的储藏室内，我们发现了一处私藏的补给点：各种消费品、氧气罐和能量电池。所有物资都经过精心囤积，并避开了官方库存系统的记录。

责任人很快被找到，他们给出的解释很简单：未雨绸缪。他们辩解称，在一个生存完全依赖于稳定性的系统中，如果理所当然地认为稳定性会永远持续下去，那才是真正的失职。从这批囤积物资的规模来看，这显然是远超个人用途的长期计划。方舟舰上并非所有人都有信心它能永存。
descriptions.en:
In a sealed storage compartment, we uncovered a private cache of supplies: consumer goods, air canisters, and power cells all carefully stockpiled and hidden from official inventory systems.

The individuals responsible were quickly found and offered a simple explanation: preparation. In a system where survival depends entirely on stability, they argued, it would be irresponsible to assume that stability is guaranteed forever. The scale of the hoard suggests long-term planning, far beyond personal use. Not all aboard the Arkship are confident that it will endure forever.

label.zh: 没收资源并取缔这场闹剧。
label.en: Confiscate and shut down this nonsense.

descriptions.zh:
在一个封闭的处理区，调查人员发现了一个未登记的回收系统，该系统旨在将生物遗骸转化为可用材料。该系统一直在持续运行，远远超出了其预设的应急功能。

尽管效率很高，但该过程耗资巨大。大量的能源、化学催化剂和加工材料被挪用，用于对有机物进行分解、消毒和提炼，将其转化为标准化产物，以便在方舟号内重复使用。方舟舰上的任何东西都不应被浪费。即便是死者。
descriptions.en:
In a sealed processing sector, investigators uncovered an unregistered reclamation system, one designed to convert biological remains into usable materials. The system has been operating continuously, far beyond its intended emergency function.

While efficient, the process is resource-intensive. Large amounts of energy, chemical catalysts, and processing materials have been diverted to break down, sterilize, and refine organic matter into standardized outputs for reuse within the Arkship. Nothing on the Arkship should be wasted. Not even the dead.

label.zh: 拆除这个处理死者的地方。
label.en: Demolish this place of the dead.

descriptions.zh:
沿着资源流失的痕迹，我们发现了方舟舰上一处长期被忽视的区域。显然，那里生活着一个脱离官方系统、与世隔绝的小型社区。他们的居所十分简陋，依靠窃取资源维持生存，但由于窃取的量极小，一直未被察觉。

尽管处境艰辛，那里的环境却很稳定，维护得十分用心，并针对他们的需求进行了改造。显而易见，这是一种深思熟虑的生活方式。他们没有做出任何反抗，反而请求解释他们的选择。
descriptions.en:
Following the traces of the disappearing resources, we found a long-overlooked section of the Arkship. Apparently there was a small isolated community living outside official systems. Their habitat was simple, sustained by siphoned resources, taken in amounts small enough to avoid detection.

Despite their circumstances, the environment was stable, attentively maintained, and adapted to their needs. It was clear this was a very deliberate way of living. They offered no resistance and instead asked to explain their choice.

label.zh: 我们不能容许这种事，净化他们。
label.en: We can't allow this, purge them.

descriptions.zh:
那群与世隔绝的人公开谈论了他们的决定。他们并非拒绝方舟舰，而是无法接受其中演变出的生活方式。在他们看来，生存已经变得过度优化：每一项行动都被衡量，每一份资源都被追踪，每一刻时光都被精算。

他们描述了一种对方舟舰体制的不同见解。他们看重在不受持续监管的情况下做出选择的自由。他们声称，自己的生活方式虽然效率较低，但更加充实。我们的领导层中，有些人现在开始质疑，这类群体的存在究竟是对凝聚力的威胁，还是封闭系统中个性表达的必要体现。
descriptions.en:
The isolated group spoke openly about their decision. They did not reject the Arkship but they said that the way life within it had evolved. To them, existence had become overly optimized: every action measured, every resource tracked, and every moment accounted for.

They described a different approach to the mechanism of the Arkship. They valued the freedom to make choices outside of constant oversight. Their way of life was less efficient, but more fulfilling, they claimed. Some among our leadership now questioned whether such communities represented a risk to cohesion, or a necessary expression of individuality within a closed system.

label.zh: 强迫他们重新融入社会。
label.en: Force to join back into society.

label.zh: 这艘方舟舰上没有你的一席之地。
label.en: There is no room for you on this Arkship.

label.zh: 随他们去，但我们会盯着他们。
label.en: Leave them be, we will keep an eye on them.

descriptions.zh:
方舟舰§Y[Root.GetName]§!上的高级工程队提交了一份结构评估报告，该报告呼吁已不能再拖延。我们的家园急需修缮。

该提案是全面的：分段轮流大修，从发电基础设施开始，然后依次进行耕作甲板、防御区和居住区。居民需要暂时搬迁。设施将停止运行。工程估算显示，根据工作进度，全面检修大约需要十到十一个标准年。

这项工作将具有破坏性。但另一种选择是，这艘船每经过一个秒差距，可靠性就会降低一分。
descriptions.en:
The senior engineering corps aboard Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§! has submitted a structural assessment that can no longer be deferred. Our home is in critical need of repair.

The proposal is comprehensive: a rotating section-by-section overhaul, beginning with the power generation infrastructure and working through the cultivation decks, the defense section, and the residential districts in sequence. Residents will need to be temporarily relocated. Facilities will be taken offline. Engineering estimates place the full overhaul at approximately ten to eleven standard years, depending on the pace of work.

The work will be disruptive. But the alternative is a vessel that grows less reliable with every parsec.

descriptions.zh:
§Y[Root.GetName]§!上的诊断子程序已标记出主结构子系统的关键阈值。方舟舰急需维修。

修复协议要求对各区段进行轮流大修。发电节点、种植区、防御基础设施和居住区将依次离线进行全面重建。在此过程中，运行连续性将有所下降。预计完成时间：以标准运行速度计算，约一百三十个月。

修复不可推迟。
descriptions.en:
Diagnostic subroutines aboard §Y[Root.GetName]§! have flagged critical thresholds across primary structural subsystems. The Arkship is in critical need of repair.

Remediation protocols mandate a rotating sector-by-sector overhaul. Power generation nodes, cultivation sectors, defense infrastructure, and residential zones will each be taken offline in sequence for comprehensive reconstruction. Operational continuity will be degraded during the process. Estimated completion timeline: approximately one hundred and thirty months at standard operational tempo.

Remediation cannot be deferred.

descriptions.zh:
集体意识到方舟舰§Y[Root.GetName]§!的状况正在恶化：承重结构在不该弯曲的地方弯曲；电力管道正在腐蚀。数代人的累积疏忽已经达到我们无法再拖延的程度。

我们需要一个全面的更新周期：逐段进行，从动力节点向外，依次经过补给舱、防御外壳和居住甲板。随着工程的进行，各个区段将被封闭，其居民将被迁离。更新周期将持续十到十一个标准年。
descriptions.en:
The collective is aware of deterioration in Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§!: load-bearing structures flex where they should not; power veins corrode. The accumulated neglect of generations has reached a threshold we can no longer defer.

We require a comprehensive renewal cycle: section by section, from the power-nodes outward through the feeding chambers, the defensive carapace, and the residential decks in sequence. Sections will be sealed and their inhabitants displaced as the work progresses. The renewal cycle will span ten to eleven standard years.

descriptions.zh:
发电基础设施已通过认证并恢复满负荷运行。施工人员已将设备运往较低的农业层。

种植平台将逐段停用。这不仅是一项结构性挑战，也是一项后勤挑战：食物储备需要精心管理，建筑残渣将在公共区域滞留数月。

工程师们说，最难的部分不是焊接，而是等待。
descriptions.en:
The power generation infrastructure has been certified and brought back to full output. Construction crews are already moving equipment down to the lower agricultural levels.

The cultivation decks will be taken offline section by section. It is not only a structural challenge but a logistical one: food stores will need careful management, and construction residue will linger in the common areas for months.

The hardest part, the engineers say, is not the welding. It is the waiting.

descriptions.zh:
发电修复已通过认证并恢复到正常输出。运营范围现在转移到第二部门基础设施。

指定区域将按顺序离线进行结构大修。受影响部门的运营输出在此过程中将按比例下降。

修复工作继续在预计参数内进行。
descriptions.en:
Power generation remediation has been certified complete and nominal output restored. Operational scope now transfers to secondary sector infrastructure.

Designated zones will be taken offline in sequence for structural overhaul. Operational output in the affected sector will decline proportionally during the process.

Remediation continues within projected parameters.

descriptions.zh:
发电机组全面恢复供电。

我们的注意力转向内部，看向维持殖民地运作的巨大供养仓。飞船上的培养槽和营养循环器官必须依次离线，进行结构翻新。食物储备已准备就绪，以弥补期间的不足。

在殖民地的“胃”重建期间，它将依靠储备食物维生。
descriptions.en:
Power generation resumes at full impact.

Our attention shifts inward, to the great feeding chambers that sustain the colony. The cultivation vats and nutrient-cycling organs of the ship must be taken offline in sequence for structural renewal. Food stores have been prepared to buffer the deficit.

The colony will feed from reserves while its stomach is rebuilt.

tooltips.zh: 消除翻修上一阶段产生的任何负面影响。
tooltips.en: Removes any negative effects incurred during the preceding phase of refurbishment.

descriptions.zh:
随着种植甲板重建和粮食生产恢复正常，注意力转向了前线防御区。从武器舱到维修走廊，一切都已勘测完毕，都需要进行维修。

在此阶段，海军战备将受到限制。负责确保飞船安全的船员们被要求暂时离开，因为他们的工作区域正在被拆开和重新组装。

据大多数说法，他们对此表现出了非凡的耐心。
descriptions.en:
With the cultivation decks rebuilt and food production returning to normal, attention shifts to the forward defense section. From the weapons bays to maintenance corridors, everything has been surveyed, and all of it needs work.

Naval readiness will be limited during this phase. The crews responsible for keeping the ship safe are being asked to step aside while their workspace is taken apart and put back together.

They have, by most accounts, been remarkably patient about it.

descriptions.zh:
二级部门修复已完成。部门产出正恢复到运行基线。修复范围现已转向前方防御基础设施。

武器舱、维护网络和安全部门设施将按顺序离线。在此阶段，海军战备指标将下降。

修复工作按预计参数继续进行。
descriptions.en:
Secondary sector remediation is complete. Sector output is returning to operational baselines. Remediation scope now shifts to forward defense infrastructure.

Weapons bays, maintenance networks, and security sector facilities will be taken offline in sequence. Naval readiness metrics will decline during this phase.

Remediation continues within projected parameters.

descriptions.zh:
饲养室得到更新，蜂群殖民地的饥饿感得以持续。

现在，我们的注意力转向甲壳：构成舰船外部防御的武器电池、维修巢穴和兵营。所有这些都必须拆除重建。战斗准备状态将会减弱。

集体接受这种暂时的脆弱性。
descriptions.en:
The feeding chambers are renewed and the colony's hunger sustained.

Our attention now turns to the carapace: the weapons batteries, maintenance warrens, and barracks that form the vessel's outer defense. All must be stripped back and rebuilt. Combat readiness will diminish.

The collective accepts this temporary vulnerability.

tooltips.zh: 消除翻修上一阶段产生的任何负面影响。
tooltips.en: Removes any negative effects incurred during the preceding phase of refurbishment.

descriptions.zh:
防御区已经检查完毕，加固并重新投入使用。负责这项工作的船员们看起来，如果非要说的话，松了一口气，终于又有事情可做了。

现在进入最后阶段：城市区本身。构成方舟舰生命核心的住宅区、市政厅和商业走廊。其他一切都是基础设施。这是居民们称之为家的地方。

施工围栏将最后一次竖起。胜利在望。
descriptions.en:
The defense section has been inspected, reinforced, and returned to service. The crews working on it looked, if anything, relieved to have something useful to do again.

Now comes the final phase: the city districts themselves. The residential blocks, civic halls, and commercial corridors that constitute the living heart of the arkship. Everything else was infrastructure. This is the place inhabitants call home.

Construction barriers will go up one last time. The end is in sight.

descriptions.zh:
防御区段的修复已确认完成。海军战备指标正恢复到基线水平。行动范围现在转向住宅和市政区基础设施。

单位处理通道将按顺序离线进行最终检修。受影响区域将需要人口疏散。

修复工作进入最后阶段。
descriptions.en:
Defense sector remediation is certified complete. Naval readiness metrics are returning to baseline. Operational scope now shifts to residential and civic district infrastructure.

Unit processing corridors will be taken offline in sequence for final overhaul. Population displacement will be required in affected sectors.

Remediation enters its final phase.

descriptions.zh:
甲壳已经硬化，集体的准备状态也已恢复。

更新现在转向其最后的工作：育婴室、公共筑巢地穴和连接通道，它们构成了飞船的生命核心。这些空间是殖民地睡觉、繁殖和聚集的地方。在我们从内部重建时，一些区域将被封闭。

更新周期即将结束。
descriptions.en:
The carapace is hardened and the collective's readiness restored.

The renewal turns now to its final work: the brood chambers, communal nesting warrens, and bonding corridors that form the living heart of the vessel. The spaces where the colony sleeps, breeds, and gathers. Sections will be sealed as we rebuild from within.

The end of the renewal cycle draws near.

tooltips.zh: 消除翻修上一阶段产生的任何负面影响。
tooltips.en: Removes any negative effects incurred during the preceding phase of refurbishment.

descriptions.zh:
由于住宅层因结构调查而被封锁，工程团队已开始了一项令人头疼的任务，即在飞船的其余部分重新安置数千名居民。最初有序的流程已演变为相互竞争的排队、管辖权争议，以及至少一份关于无法进入水培舱一个特别受欢迎区域的正式投诉。

飞船的社会协调员正在请求指导。
descriptions.en:
With the residential levels sealed for structural survey, engineering teams have begun the unenviable task of redistributing thousands of inhabitants across the rest of the ship. What began as an orderly process has devolved into competing queues, jurisdiction disputes, and at least one formal complaint about lost access to a particularly beloved section of the hydroponics bay.

The ship's social coordinators are requesting guidance.

descriptions.zh:
单位向可用作战区域的重新部署遇到了处理瓶颈。单位正在做出实时决策以弥补，导致优先级冲突。再部署节点的效率指标已下降。

需要指导。
descriptions.en:
The redistribution of units to available operational zones has encountered processing bottlenecks. Units are making real-time decisions to compensate, leading to clashing prioritization. Efficiency metrics have declined across redistribution junctions.

Guidance is required.

descriptions.zh:
子个体的迁移扰乱了蜂群的凝聚力。由于流离失所的子个体在过度拥挤的次要区域争夺筑巢区和工作分配，领地本能显现出来。在整个临时住所中都可以检测到压力和不安的信息素痕迹。

蜂群需要指导。
descriptions.en:
The displacement of drones has unsettled the colony's cohesion. Territorial instincts assert themselves as displaced drones contest nesting zones and work assignments in the overcrowded secondary areas. Pheromone traces of stress and agitation are detectable throughout the temporary quarters.

The colony requires direction.

tooltips.zh: 绕过标准流程。最终工作质量可能会受到影响。
tooltips.en: Bypasses standard procedure. The quality of the final work may suffer.

label.zh: 建立一个公平的分配机制。

descriptions.zh:
拆除发电机区的导管套管后，发现了一些原始图纸中没有显示的东西：一段三米长的结构主梁，出现了严重的疲劳断裂。材料测定表明，这种损坏已经存在了几十年，但一直未被发现。

扩大施工范围以解决损坏问题将需要额外的时间。
descriptions.en:
Removal of conduit casings in the generator district revealed something none of the original schematics showed: a three-meter section of structural spine exhibiting advanced fatigue fracturing. Material dating suggests the damage has been present, undetected, for decades.

Expanding the scope of construction to address the damage will take additional time.

label.zh: 记录下来，然后按原计划进行。
label.en: Document it and proceed as planned.

tooltips.zh: 绕过标准流程。最终工作质量可能会受到影响。
tooltips.en: Bypasses standard procedure. The quality of the final work may suffer.

label.zh: 扩大翻修范围。将这处断裂处妥善处理。
label.en: Expand the scope. Address it properly.

descriptions.zh:
未受持续翻新工程影响的居民抱怨不得不与搬迁人员共用住所。

他们要求增加资源分配，优先使用娱乐设施，并立即移除一个自动化广播系统，该系统每三小时提醒他们，他们的不便是“暂时的且受到感谢的”。
descriptions.en:
Residents of sections unaffected by the ongoing refurbishment are complaining at having to share quarters with relocated individuals.

They are requesting expanded resource allocations, priority access to recreation facilities, and the immediate removal of an automated announcement system that reminds them, every three hours, that their disruption is 'temporary and appreciated.'

descriptions.zh:
由于人口重新分配，分配给过度拥挤的次级区域的单位凝聚力读数已显著下降。生产力产出低于最佳阈值。预测模型表明，如果不进行干预，这种趋势将恶化。

已建议有针对性地分配额外资源以恢复基线凝聚力。
descriptions.en:
Cohesion readings among units assigned to overcrowded secondary zones have declined measurably since the population redistribution. Productivity outputs are tracking below optimal thresholds. Predictive models indicate the trend will worsen without intervention.

A targeted allocation of additional resources has been recommended to restore baseline cohesion.

descriptions.zh:
过度拥挤的次级筑巢区信息素应激水平自迁徙开始以来稳步上升。被迁集群和常驻种群之间的领土紧张关系显著加剧。随着本能骚动在受影响区域蔓延，蜂巢的集体生产力正在下降。

已建议增加补充资源以缓解拥挤。
descriptions.en:
Pheromone stress levels in the overcrowded secondary nesting zones have risen steadily since the relocation began. Territorial tension between displaced clusters and resident populations is measurably elevated. The hive's collective productivity is declining as instinctive agitation spreads through the affected sectors.

Supplemental resources have been recommended to ease the crowding.

label.zh: 这要不了太久。我们能够管控这一局势。
label.en: It won't be long. We will manage.

tooltips.zh: 绕过标准流程。最终工作质量可能会受到影响。
tooltips.en: Bypasses standard procedure. The quality of the final work may suffer.

descriptions.zh:
为赶上施工进度，首席工程师提议实行三班倒，24小时不间断施工。施工区域附近的住宅区报告称，噪音水平已导致居民连续十一天难以休息。三名施工人员已因疲劳相关事故接受治疗。

施工队本身也出现了疲劳的迹象。虽然速度可能更快了，但负责人对疲惫的施工队所完成的工作质量并不抱太大信心。
descriptions.en:
To maintain the construction schedule, the lead engineer has proposed running three overlapping shifts around the clock. The residential decks adjacent to the work zone report noise levels that have made rest nearly impossible for eleven straight days. Three crew members have been treated for fatigue-related incidents.

The construction crews themselves are showing signs of strain. Faster, perhaps, but those in charge are not confident in the quality of work produced by exhausted crews.

descriptions.zh:
为维持进度，已在所有活跃工区施工单位中提出连续作业周期。来自邻近居民区的噪声和振动数据显示，持续干扰已超过容忍阈值。已记录到多起设备运行故障。

质量保证指标正与周期延长成比例下降。连续作业虽然更快，但错误率显著增加。
descriptions.en:
To maintain schedule, a continuous-operation cycle has been proposed across all construction units in the active work zone. Noise and vibration data from adjacent residential sectors indicate sustained disruption above tolerance thresholds. Several unit operational failures have been logged.

Quality assurance metrics are declining proportionally to cycle extension. Continuous operation is faster but increases error rates measurably.

descriptions.zh:
为维持更新周期，活跃施工区域的无人机已被指示长时间运行。相邻筑巢区的振动和噪音水平已连续十一个周期超出可容忍阈值。几架无人机已出现疲劳性故障迹象。

持续工作确实加快了施工速度，但群体的生物极限对工作质量造成了可衡量的损失。
descriptions.en:
To maintain the renewal cycle, the drones in the active construction zone has been directed to operate for prolonged periods. Vibration and noise levels in adjacent nesting areas have exceeded tolerable thresholds for eleven consecutive cycles. Several drones have shown signs of exhaustion-related breakdown.

Continuous labor drives construction faster, but the colony's biological limits impose a measurable cost in work quality.

tooltips.zh: 绕过标准流程。最终工作质量可能会受到影响。
tooltips.en: Bypasses standard procedure. The quality of the final work may suffer.

label.zh: 建立适度的轮换排班机制。

descriptions.zh:
一根主电源导管在拆除旧外壳时破裂。整个区域，包括住宅层、次级医务室和两个食品加工单元，现在仅靠应急照明运行。

我们的[Owner.GetEngineerPlural]认为，有可能在几个月内恢复全部电力。或者，可以通过绕过导管的路径，从相邻的发电机组获取电力。这种方法更快，但这会在电网中引入一个永久性的应急改动。
descriptions.en:
A primary power conduit has ruptured during removal of the old casing. The entire section, including the residential levels, the secondary medical bay, and two food processing units, is now running on emergency lighting only.

Our [Owner.GetEngineerPlural] believe it will be possible to restore full power within a few months. Alternatively, the conduit's routing can be bypassed, drawing from an adjacent generator cluster instead. Faster, but it introduces a permanent workaround into the power grid.

tooltips.zh: 绕过标准流程。最终工作质量可能会受到影响。
tooltips.en: Bypasses standard procedure. The quality of the final work may suffer.

descriptions.zh:
项目首席结构工程师提交了一份正式担忧：目前的工期虽然可以实现，但产出的工作成果[Owner.Ruler.GetSheHe]本人不会认证为合格。

非关键连接点正在被密封而不是适当加固。公差裕度被设定为“可接受”而非“推荐”。
descriptions.en:
The project's lead structural engineer has submitted a formal concern: the current timeline, while achievable, is producing work [Owner.Ruler.GetSheHe] would not personally certify as complete.

Non-critical junction points are being sealed over rather than properly reinforced. Tolerance margins are being set to 'acceptable' rather than 'recommended.'

descriptions.zh:
质量保证监督子程序已标记出一个结构性问题：当前的施工参数在最低容差阈值内运行，而非推荐规格。非关键连接节点正在被结项，而非优化。长期结构余量预测低于首选目标。

已登记正式日志条目。未显示即时故障风险。
descriptions.en:
The quality assurance oversight subroutine has flagged a structural concern: current construction parameters are operating within minimum tolerance thresholds rather than recommended specifications. Non-critical junction nodes are being finalized rather than optimized. Long-term structural margin projections are below preferred targets.

A formal log entry has been registered. No immediate failure risk is indicated.

descriptions.zh:
目前的翻新速度使得工作成果仅达到最低可行标准，而非推荐规格。连接节点被简单地封固，而非得到妥善加固。长期结构韧性被牺牲以换取短期速度。

目前没有迹象表明存在即时故障风险。相关担忧已记录在案。
descriptions.en:
The current pace of refurbishment is producing work at the minimum viable threshold, not the recommended specification. Junction nodes are being sealed in place rather than properly reinforced. Long-term structural resilience is being traded for short-term speed.

No immediate failure risk is indicated. The concern has been registered.

label.zh: 日程表保持不变。只要看上去过得去，那就过去。
label.en: The schedule holds. Acceptable is acceptable.

tooltips.zh: 绕过标准流程。最终工作质量可能会受到影响。
tooltips.en: Bypasses standard procedure. The quality of the final work may suffer.

label.en: Heed the warning. Correct the parameters.

descriptions.zh:
首个完成大修的区段已被宣布结构上合格，并获准重新使用。这项工作确实令人印象深刻：新的框架、现代化的管道、以及绝不会一碰即碎的绝缘材料。

工程团队渴望继续推进。居民们也迫不及待地想搬回来。然而，全套系统测试尚未完成。需要做出一个决定。
descriptions.en:
The first section to complete its overhaul has been declared structurally certified and cleared for reoccupation. The work is genuinely impressive: new framing, modernized conduits, insulation that doesn't crumble at the touch.

The engineering team is eager to push forward. Residents are clamoring to move back in. However, the full battery of systems tests hasn't been completed. A decision will need to be made.

descriptions.zh:
一次重大结构翻修已经完成。初步认证表明该区段符合最低重新占用标准。全面的诊断测试规程仍未完成。重大入住后故障的可能性较低但并非可以忽略。

无论是否完成诊断，都需要授权才能继续。
descriptions.en:
A major structural refurbishment is complete. Initial certification indicates the sector meets minimum reoccupation standards. Full diagnostic testing protocols remain outstanding. Probability of significant post-occupancy failure is low but non-negligible.

Authorization is required to proceed with or without complete diagnostics.

descriptions.zh:
首个完成结构更新的区段已通过初步检查。它达到了重新使用的最低门槛。其重建系统的完整生物验证周期尚未完成。重新使用后的故障概率很低，但并非可以忽略不计。

从该区域撤离的无人机已在屏障处施压。
descriptions.en:
The first section to complete its structural renewal has been cleared by initial inspection. It meets the minimum threshold for reoccupation. The full biological verification cycle for its rebuilt systems has not yet been completed. Failure probability after reoccupation is low, but not negligible.

The drones displaced from this section are already pressing at the barriers.

tooltips.zh: 绕过标准流程。最终工作质量可能会受到影响。
tooltips.en: Bypasses standard procedure. The quality of the final work may suffer.

descriptions.zh:
项目主管已经编制了最终的维修清单：在正式结构签收前还有四十七个未完成项目。清单上的项目范围很广，从重要的，例如后部区域的三个承重连接升级，到美观性的，包括十九处面板未对齐和一处通风格栅装反了。

完成清单上的每一项都需要额外的时间。但这份清单之所以存在，正是因为这些事情很重要。
descriptions.en:
The project supervisor has compiled the final list of repairs: forty-seven outstanding items before formal structural sign-off. The list ranges from the significant, such as three load-bearing junction upgrades in the aft section, to the cosmetic, including nineteen instances of misaligned paneling and one ventilation grille installed upside-down.

Completing every item on the list will take additional time. But the list exists precisely because these things matter.

descriptions.zh:
质量保证协议已经生成了一份补救清单，其中包含四十七项待正式认证的项目。这些项目从结构重要性（如接点加固）到外观面板对齐都有涉及。

全面完成将需要延长运营时间。只涵盖结构项目，形成一个次优化的分项认证是一个可选方案。
descriptions.en:
Quality assurance protocols have generated a remediation checklist of forty-seven outstanding items pending formal certification. Items range from structural significance, such as junction reinforcement, to cosmetic panel alignment.

Full completion will require an extension of the operational timeline. Partial certification, covering structural items only, is an option.

descriptions.zh:
维修工蜂已编制了一份最终清单：在最近完成的区段中，有四十七处胞元修复不完整。这些修复工作从承重连接处的关键结构加固，到表面胞元内衬和美容腔体修复，不一而足。

全面完成将延长更新周期。我们也可以考虑只获得部分认证，仅涉及结构修复部分。
descriptions.en:
Repair drones have compiled a final manifest: forty-seven incomplete cell repairs across the most recently finished sections. They range from critical structural reinforcements at load-bearing junctions to surface-level cell-lining and cosmetic cavity work.

Full completion will extend the renewal cycle. Partial certification, addressing structural repairs, is available.

tooltips.zh: 绕过标准流程。最终工作质量可能会受到影响。
tooltips.en: Bypasses standard procedure. The quality of the final work may suffer.

label.zh: 完成整个修复清单的任务。

descriptions.zh:
最新翻修部分的流离居民已经收到了他们迁回的日期。那些被封闭了数月的走廊再次开放，散发着新鲜复合材料和新绝缘材料的气味。那些在临时住所待了数月的婴儿们第一次看到了他们的家。

船上的气氛是自翻修开始以来最好的。领导层意识到这种善意不会持久。问题是如何利用它。
descriptions.en:
The displaced residents of the most recently renovated section have been given their move-back date. The corridors that were sealed for months are open again, smelling of fresh composite and new insulation. Infants who spent months in temporary quarters are seeing their home section for the first time.

The mood aboard is the best it has been since the refurbishment began. Leadership is aware that goodwill of this kind does not last. The question is how to make use of it.

descriptions.zh:
密封的走廊再次开放。下层甲板的脚手架正在拆除。对大多数人来说，这是回家。对一些人来说，却是别样的体验。

在迁徙期间新近启动的单元正在进入那些仅存在于其数据库图纸中，但从未出现在其感官日志中的走廊。

自翻新开始以来，热情达到了顶峰。领导层知道这不会持久。问题是如何利用它。
descriptions.en:
The sealed corridors are open again. Scaffolding comes down in the lower decks. For most, this is a homecoming. For some, it is something else.

Units that came online during the displacement period are entering corridors that appear in their schematics but have never appeared in their sensory logs.

Enthusiasm is the highest it has been since the refurbishment began. Leadership is aware that this will not last. The question is how to make use of it.

descriptions.zh:
分配到修复期间临时作业区的单位正在返回其主要处理区域。受影响区域的基线操作参数正在恢复。效率指标呈上升趋势。

飞船范围内已记录到可测量的凝聚力提升。此类提升是暂时的。分析表明有两种可行方法：将提升重定向以加速剩余的修复工作，或允许自然稳定并使凝聚力稳定在更高的基线水平。
descriptions.en:
Units assigned to temporary operational zones during remediation are being returned to their primary processing areas. Baseline operational parameters are being restored across affected sectors. Efficiency metrics are trending upward.

A measurable cohesion uplift has been registered across the vessel. Such spikes are transient. Analysis indicates two viable approaches: redirect the uplift toward accelerating remaining remediation work, or permit natural stabilization and allow cohesion to settle at an elevated baseline.

descriptions.zh:
流离失所的工蜂正回流到它们修复好的区域。曾经散发着几个周期建筑材料气味的走廊，现在充满了熟悉的嗅觉标记。结合化学作用趋于稳定。领地紧张感消散。

集体共鸣激增。蜂巢正在恢复原状，这种回归的能量是真实的。它可以被导向外部，进入剩余的建筑区。或者，也可以让它安定下来，给蜂群时间在工作恢复之前完全找回自我。
descriptions.en:
The displaced drones are flowing back into their restored sections. Familiar scent-markers saturate corridors that smelled of construction compounds for cycles. Bonding chemistry stabilizes. Territorial tension dissolves.

The collective resonance has spiked. The hive is returning to itself, and the energy of that return is real. It could be directed outward, into the remaining construction zones. Or it could be allowed to settle, and the colony given time to fully find itself again before the work resumes.

label.zh: 将重点重新放回工作上。

tooltips.zh: 绕过标准流程。最终工作质量可能会受到影响。
tooltips.en: Bypasses standard procedure. The quality of the final work may suffer.

descriptions.zh:
居民区翻新工程已进入最后阶段，但“最后”这个词的含义已经今非昔比。从市区迁出的居民在临时住所居住的时间已经超出了最初的估计。

现在有要求提供额外资源：更好的临时家具、优先使用娱乐设施，以及少量额外资源分配。这并不能解决任何结构性问题。但它可能会让等待变得更容易忍受。
descriptions.en:
The residential district renovation is in its final stage, but 'final' has stopped meaning what it once did. The inhabitants relocated from the city blocks have now been in temporary quarters for longer than the original estimate promised.

A request has come through for supplemental resources: better temporary furnishings, priority access to recreational facilities, and a small additional resource allocation. It will not fix anything structural. But it might make the waiting bearable.

descriptions.zh:
从居民区被迫搬离的人员凝聚力数据正低于可接受的阈值。最终改造阶段已超出其预计持续时间。预测模型显示，如不进行有针对性的资源干预，情况将持续恶化。

补充拨款申请已提交审核。
descriptions.en:
Unit cohesion data from displaced residential sector populations is trending below acceptable thresholds. The final renovation phase has exceeded its projected duration. Predictive models indicate continued decline without targeted resource intervention.

A supplemental allocation request has been submitted for review.

descriptions.zh:
最终居住区的信息素压力读数已超过可接受的阈值。上一次翻新阶段已超出其预计周期。长期脱离既定模式会扰乱结合化学并损害集体凝聚力，且随着时间推移情况会恶化。

已请求额外资源分配以缓解拥挤。
descriptions.en:
Pheromone stress readings from the final residential sections have exceeded acceptable thresholds. The last renovation phase has extended beyond its projected cycle. Prolonged separation from established patterns disrupts bonding chemistry and undermines collective cohesion in ways that worsen with time.

A supplemental resource allocation has been requested to alleviate the crowding.

label.zh: 在工作完成前我们可以忍耐。
label.en: We endure until the work is done.

tooltips.zh: 绕过标准流程。最终工作质量可能会受到影响。
tooltips.en: Bypasses standard procedure. The quality of the final work may suffer.

descriptions.zh:
在住宅区中部拆除非承重墙时，装修工人发现了一些异常情况：几十年来未经授权的改动。隐藏的房间、私自搭建的壁龛、被改造成储藏室或居住空间的封闭走廊。这些都不在原始设计图中，而且其中一些还是承重结构。

首席工程师正在请求决策。拆除所有不在原始计划中的部分是正确的做法。这将需要时间。绕过这些改动会更快，但会引入结构不规则性，这将很难向未来的工程师解释。
descriptions.en:
During demolition of non-load-bearing walls in the mid-residential sections, the renovation crews have discovered something unusual: decades of unauthorized modifications. Hidden rooms, self-constructed alcoves, sealed corridors repurposed as storage or living space. None of it is in the original schematics, and some of it is load-bearing.

The lead engineer is requesting a decision. Removing everything not in the original plans is the correct approach. It will take time. Working around the modifications is faster, but introduces structural irregularities that will be difficult to explain to future engineers.

descriptions.zh:
对住宅部门非结构性元素的拆解过程中，我们发现了大量未经授权的建筑改造。在多个区域发现了未经备案的隔断、通道改动和临时承重装置。这些都没有在原始设计规范中记录。

完全拆除在结构上是正确的，但耗时。文档记录和变通路线可作为替代方案。
descriptions.en:
Deconstruction of residential sector non-structural elements has revealed extensive unauthorized architectural modifications. Off-record partitioning, access route alterations, and improvised load-bearing installations have been identified across multiple zones. None are documented in original design specifications.

Full removal is structurally correct but time-consuming. Documentation and workaround routing is available as an alternative.

descriptions.zh: 拆除中层居住区的内墙后，我们发现了数代未经授权的殖民地改造。隐蔽的洞穴、自行挖掘的通道、改作巢穴的密封空间，所有这些都完全不在飞船的正式结构中。其中一些是承重结构。正确移除是正确的做法，但耗时。绕开它们更快，但会引入结构不规则性，这将给未来的巢穴管理员带来麻烦。
descriptions.en: Demolition of interior walls in the mid-residential sections has uncovered generations of unauthorized colony modification. Hidden burrows, self-bored access tunnels, sealed chambers repurposed as nesting alcoves, and each entirely absent from the vessel's formal structure. Some are load-bearing. Proper removal is the correct approach but time-consuming. Working around them is faster, but introduces structural irregularities that will trouble future nest-wardens.

label.zh: 能记录的记录下来。剩下的想办法解决。
label.en: Document what we can. Work around the rest.

tooltips.zh: 绕过标准流程。最终工作质量可能会受到影响。
tooltips.en: Bypasses standard procedure. The quality of the final work may suffer.

label.zh: 移除所有不符合原始规划的内容。
label.en: Remove everything not in the original specifications.

descriptions.zh:
最后一层甲板已通过初步检查。下方部分的脚手架已开始拆除。从大多数方面来看，翻修工作已完成。

工程主管要求进行全面的二次检查，之后[Owner.Ruler.GetSheHe]才会签署结构认证。他们承认，这在很大程度上只是一种形式。甲板几乎肯定没有问题。

然而，“几乎”这个词往往会带来后果。
descriptions.en:
The last deck has passed its preliminary inspection. The scaffolding has already started coming down in the lower sections. By most measures, the renovation is complete.

The engineering supervisor has requested a full secondary inspection before [Owner.Ruler.GetSheHe] signs off on structural certification. It is, they acknowledge, largely a formality. The deck is almost certainly fine.

However, 'almost' is a word that often bears consequences.

descriptions.zh:
最终的住宅区已通过初步检查协议。低层区域的脚手架拆除工作已经开始。结构认证正等待完整的二次诊断协议。

二次检查几乎是肯定是不会有问题的，但获得完全认证的是全面完工的正式先决条件。
descriptions.en:
The final residential sector has passed preliminary inspection protocols. Scaffolding removal has commenced in lower zones. Structural certification is pending full secondary diagnostic protocols.

The secondary inspection is a near certainty, but completion remains a formal prerequisite for full certification.

descriptions.zh:
最终的巢穴甲板已通过初步检查。工蜂正在拆除低层的脚手架。从所有可观察到的迹象来看，翻修已完成。在最终认证前，还需要进行全面的二次验证循环。

我们几乎可以肯定——但并非完全肯定——二次验证和初次检查的结果将保持一致。
descriptions.en:
The final nesting deck has cleared its preliminary inspection. Drones are dismantling the scaffolding in the lower levels. By every observable measure, the renewal is complete. A full secondary verification cycle is necessary before final certification.

We are almost, but not entirely, certain it will confirm what the primary inspection found.

label.zh: 几乎完工就已经算完工了。

tooltips.zh: 绕过标准流程。最终工作质量可能会受到影响。
tooltips.en: Bypasses standard procedure. The quality of the final work may suffer.

descriptions.zh:
方舟舰§Y[Target.GetName]§!的最后一个区段已完成清理、认证，并已归还给居民。虽然最初出于必要性我们对部分区域实行了破坏工程，但最终我们的工程铸就了一项伟大的成就。飞船给人的感觉焕然一新：不仅结构坚固，而且在某种程度上更像是它本应成为的飞船。

工程兵团已提交最终报告，并附有几项强烈建议。如何利用这项工作的成果，将由领导层决定。
descriptions.en:
The last section of Arkship §Y[Target.GetName]§! has been cleared, certified, and returned to its inhabitants. What began as a disruptive necessity has concluded as something approaching an achievement. The ship feels different: not just structurally sound, but somehow more like the vessel it was always supposed to be.

The engineering corps has submitted its final report with several strong recommendations. The choice of where to direct the fruits of this work belongs to leadership.

descriptions.zh:
方舟舰§Y[Target.GetName]§!的检修已宣布完成。结构完整性评估证实，与基准相比，性能有了显著改善，尽管熟悉最初提案的人会注意到并非所有需求规格都已达成，也并非所有公差都已优化。

项目取得了成果。但本可以做得更好。
descriptions.en:
The overhaul of Arkship §Y[Target.GetName]§! has been declared complete. Structural integrity assessments confirm a meaningful improvement over baseline, though those familiar with the original proposal will note that not every specification was met, and not every tolerance was optimal.

The project delivered results. The results could have been better.

descriptions.zh:
方舟舰§Y[Target.GetName]§!的检修已完成。文件已签署，脚手架已拆除，施工组成员也已离开。

结构审查委员会以某种外交辞令指出，最终产品在所有评估类别中都达到了最低认证标准。这艘船比以前更好了。至于它是否达到了最佳状态，工程兵团选择了不公开质疑。
descriptions.en:
The overhaul of Arkship §Y[Target.GetName]§! is done. The paperwork is signed, the scaffolding is down, and the crews have moved on.

The structural review board has noted, with some diplomatic restraint, that the final product meets minimum certification standards across all assessed categories. The ship is better than it was. Whether it is as good as it could have been is a question the engineering corps has chosen not to ask aloud.

descriptions.zh:
§Y[Target.GetName]§!的修复工作已完成。所有区域均已通过认证并恢复全面运行状态。结构完整性评估证实，在所有测量类别中，输出均超过修复前的基线。

最终报告已记录。优化建议可供实施。
descriptions.en:
Remediation of §Y[Target.GetName]§! is complete. All sectors have been certified and returned to full operational status. Structural integrity assessments confirm outputs exceeding pre-remediation baselines across every measured category.

Final reporting has been logged. Optimization recommendations are available for implementation.

descriptions.zh:
§Y[Target.GetName]§!的修复已确认完成。结构完整性评估证实，修复后情况较修复前基线有所改善。然而，有几个参数是在最低阈值而非建议规范下最终确定的。

结果在可接受范围内。
descriptions.en:
Remediation of §Y[Target.GetName]§! has been certified as complete. Structural integrity assessments confirm improvement over pre-remediation baselines. However, several parameters were finalized at minimum threshold rather than recommended specification.

Outcomes are within acceptable range.

descriptions.zh:
§Y[Target.GetName]§!的修复已记录为最终完成。结构审查子程序已认证该结果符合所有评估类别的最低标准。

相对于基线的运行改进已确认。优化潜力未完全实现。
descriptions.en:
Remediation of §Y[Target.GetName]§! has been logged as finalized. The structural review subroutine has certified the outcome as meeting minimum standards across all assessed categories.

Operational improvement over baseline is confirmed. Optimization potential was not fully realized.

descriptions.zh:
§Y[Target.GetName]§!的翻新已完成。每个部分都经过验证、重建，并已归还给殖民地。集体以新的连贯性共鸣着，熟悉的重量如同一个再次完整的容器，从最深处的能源节点到最高的筑巢室都结构完好。

我们完整了。殖民地选择将其新生的力量导向何处。
descriptions.en:
The renewal of §Y[Target.GetName]§! is complete. Every section has been verified, rebuilt, and returned to the colony. The collective resonates with new coherence, the familiar weight of a vessel that is once again fully itself, structurally sound from the deepest power-nodes to the highest nesting chambers.

We are whole. The colony chooses where its renewed strength is directed.

descriptions.zh:
§Y[Target.GetName]§!的续建已宣布完成。结构评估证实，相较于该船之前的状态，它确实得到了改善。我们不安地意识到，并非所有规范都得到了满足，也并非所有结构裕度都得到了充分优化。

殖民地变得更强大了。尽管它本可以更强大。
descriptions.en:
The renewal of §Y[Target.GetName]§! has been declared complete. Structural assessments confirm real improvement over the vessel's prior state. We are uncomfortably aware that not every specification was met and not every structural margin was fully optimized.

The colony is stronger. It could have been stronger still.

descriptions.zh:
§Y[Target.GetName]§!的翻新已经完成。脚手架已拆除，区域已开放，被转移的工蜂已返回指定位置。我们不安地意识到，我们在所有评估类别中仅达到了最低认证标准。

翻新达到了其目的。至于它是否发挥了其潜力，我们选择不去深究。
descriptions.en:
The renewal of §Y[Target.GetName]§! is done. Scaffolding is down, sections are open, and the displaced drones have returned to their assigned locations.We are uncomfortably aware that we achieved the bare minimum certification standards across all assessed categories.

The renewal achieved its purpose. Whether it achieved its potential is something we choose not to dwell on.

label.zh: 将资源直接用于栽培系统。
label.en: Direct resources to the cultivation systems.
Invest in the defense systems overhaul.

descriptions.zh:
我们的远程扫描仪发现了一个在系统边缘漂浮的物体。进一步检查发现其外表下存在精确的几何不一致，以及厚厚岩石外壳下埋藏的休眠能量信号。

这是一个来源不明的救生舱，其外部经过伪装，以躲避广阔太空中的探测。未检测到任何主动传输，但舱内仍存在微弱的生命维持痕迹。无论里面是什么，都已经漂浮了很长时间。
descriptions.en:
Our long-range scanners have flagged an object drifting at the edge of the system. Closer inspection revealed precise geometric inconsistencies beneath its surface, and dormant power signatures buried beneath a thick shell of rock.

A survival pod of unknown origin, its exterior was camouflaged to evade detection across vast stretches of space. No active transmissions were detected, but faint life-support traces persisted within. Whatever lay inside had been adrift for a very long time.

label.zh: 让我们看看里面有什么。
就把这石头当石头看吧。
label.en: Let the rock be a rock.

descriptions.zh:
矿物外壳之下，我们发现了一个严重受损的休眠舱。舱内有一名乘员，早已死亡。此人的身体披着华丽的仪式长袍，不适合太空旅行。看来此人是被仓促地强行塞进去的。

休眠舱内部有明显的暴力痕迹。几处内部束缚装置曾被强行使用。这个容器并非避难所，而是一个囚牢。只找到了两件物品：一组坐标和一封密封的信件。上面刻着简单的铭文：

§H“致吾爱。”§!
descriptions.en:
Beneath the mineral shell, we uncovered a badly damaged stasis pod. Inside we discovered a single occupant, already deceased. Their body was draped in flowing ceremonial vestments, not suited for spacefaring. It appears they were forced inside in haste.

The pod's interior bore unmistakable signs of violence. Several internal restraints had been forcibly engaged. This vessel was no sanctuary; it was a prison. Only two artifacts could be recovered: a set of coordinates, and a sealed message. It bore a simple inscription: 

§H"For my Beloved."§!

label.zh: 设置前往该坐标的航线。
我们不应该在这上面浪费时间。
label.en: We should not waste our time on this.

descriptions.zh:
我们终于抵达了由恢复的坐标所指向的休眠舱。在里面，我们发现了另一个生物，它还奄奄一息。

身体损伤非常严重。长期的休眠失败让[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHimHer]濒临死亡。两个休眠舱显然很久以前就已分离，从未抵达目的地。

我们已经稳定住了这个外星人，它要求我们称呼[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHimHer]为[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]。完全康复仍遥遥无期。
descriptions.en:
We have finally arrived at the capsule indicated by the recovered coordinates. Within, we discovered another being, this one still barely alive.

The physical damage is severe. Prolonged stasis failure has left [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHimHer] on the verge of death. The two pods had clearly been separated long ago, their destination never reached.

We have stabilized the alien, who has asked us to call [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHimHer] [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]. Full recovery remains far from certain.

descriptions.zh:
[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]的证词是在[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer]康复期间记录的：

§H“发生了一场大屠杀。整个家庭被抹去。根据官方通告，那是一个敌对帝国的袭击。但那是一个谎言。当权者自己策划了这一切，一个捏造的暴行，只为了一场毫无意义的战争辩护。我的爱人和我找到了证据。内部指令。未篡改的日志。

“我们发布了它。我们预料到了后果。我们没有预料到的是流放。”§!

休眠舱数据库虽然有所损坏，但该记录可恢复。这份记录现在掌握在我们手中。
descriptions.en:
[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]'s account was recorded during [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer] recovery:

§H"There was a massacre. Whole families, erased. It was presented as an attack by a rival empire. But that was a lie. Those in power had orchestrated it themselves, a fabricated atrocity to justify a senseless war. My beloved and I found the proof. Internal directives. Unaltered logs.

"We released it. We expected consequences. What we did not expect was exile."§!

Corrupted but recoverable records from the pod's data banks are already in our possession.

label.zh: 我们找到了你爱人的留言。
label.en: We found a message from your beloved.

descriptions.zh:
[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]的证词在[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer]康复期间被完整记录下来：

§H“舰队已然逼近，我们早在他们抵达之前就看到了。自我们拒绝[event_target:star_crossed_empire.GetName]的臣服要求以来，他们已经对我们发动了多年的战争。我们的军队实力悬殊，根本无法匹敌。

“最终，我的父母将他们的希望寄托在这些休眠舱上。他们把我和我所爱的人强行送入虚空，我们的生存渺茫，我们的重逢只能听天由命，只希望能重新开始。”§!

对休眠舱系统进行调查后，我们发现了许多战时工程数据。
descriptions.en:
[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]'s account was recorded in full during [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer] recovery:

§H"The fleets were already on approach, we saw them long before they reached us. [event_target:star_crossed_empire.GetName] had waged war against us for years, ever since we refused their demands for vassalage. Our forces were hopelessly outmatched.

"In the end, my parents placed their faith in these capsules. They forced my beloved and me into the void, our survival uncertain, our reunion left to chance with only the hope that we might begin anew."§!

A survey of the pod's systems has turned up engineering data from the war period.

label.zh: 我们找到了你爱人的留言。
label.en: We found a message from your beloved.

descriptions.zh:
[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]在[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer]康复期间，完整地记录了其陈述：

§H“我们的帝国曾以尊重生命和死亡为荣。我们的宗旨是延长生命，并减轻生死之间的过渡，但绝不是完全超越它。通过机械飞升实现永生，是对我们信仰的亵渎。这种知识本不该被掌握。但好奇心在民众中蔓延开来。当它无法再被遏制时，统治当局认为风险不可接受。

“他们选择了抹除。我们的帝国被摧毁以埋葬真相。只有我和我的爱人幸免于难，被迫进入这些休眠舱，注定在生与死之间漂泊。”§!

休眠舱的数据核心也已解密。
descriptions.en:
[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]'s account was recorded in full during [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer] recovery:

§H"Our empire once took great pride in honoring both life and death. Our purpose was to prolong existence and ease the passage between them, but never to transcend it entirely. Immortality, through synthetic ascension, was an abomination to our beliefs. Such knowledge was never meant to be possessed. But curiosity spread among the population. When it could no longer be contained, the ruling authority deemed the risk unacceptable.

"They chose erasure. Our empire was destroyed to bury the truth. Only my beloved and I were spared, forced into these pods, condemned to drift between life and death."§!

The pod's data core has also been decrypted.

label.zh: 我们找到了你爱人的留言。
label.en: We found a message from your beloved.

descriptions.zh:
[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]在[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer]康复期间记录下了这份自述：

§H“我有个同事。一个朋友，至少我是这么认为的。我们一起工作了好几年。当我被任命领导这个项目时，[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHeShe]向我表示了祝贺。

“一个月后，我和我的爱人被捕了。莫须有的罪名。没有审判。我还没来得及问为什么，我们就被关进了休眠舱。我现在明白了，野心不需要理由。它只需要一个机会。”§!

来自休眠舱内部系统的个人日志为我们提供了帝国治理的详细记录。
descriptions.en:
[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]'s account was recorded during [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer] recovery:

§H"I had a colleague. A friend, or so I believed. We had worked together for years. When I was appointed to lead the project, [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHeShe] offered congratulations.

"A month later, my beloved and I were seized. Fabricated charges. No trial. We were put into the pods before I had finished asking why. I know now that ambition does not need a reason. It only needs an opportunity."§!

Personal logs from the pod's internal systems have given us a detailed record of the empire's governance.

label.zh: 我们找到了你爱人的留言。
label.en: We found a message from your beloved.

descriptions.zh:
[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]的陈述在[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer]康复期间被完整记录下来：

§H“一种无情的病毒席卷了我们的帝国。我们的人民迅速而无情地死去。据信它起源于我们庞大的垃圾填埋场之一，这是我们自身过度和粗心大意的后果。我所爱的人和我在末日来临之前选择与我们的人民站在一起。

“但我的父母介入了。违背我们的意愿，我们被迫进入这些休眠仓，被抛弃。这项技术本应保存我们。看来它失败了。”§!

已回收休眠仓生命维持系统中的生物残留物。
descriptions.en:
[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]'s account was recorded in full during [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer] recovery:

§H"A relentless virus swept through our empire. Our people perished swiftly and without mercy. It is believed to have originated from one of our vast landfill complexes, a consequence of our own excess and carelessness. My beloved and I chose to remain to stand with our people until the end.

"But my parents intervened. Against our will, we were forced into these pods and cast away. The technology was meant to preserve us. It seems it failed."§!

Biological residue from the pod's life support systems has been recovered.

label.zh: 我们找到了你爱人的留言。
label.en: We found a message from your beloved.

descriptions.zh:
[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]在康复期间完整记录了[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer]的叙述：

§H“我的父母知道[event_target:star_crossed_empire.GetName]即将苏醒。为了获得它的青睐，他们不惜一切代价达成了一项交易。我们四分之一的人口被献祭，以换取力量。我和我的爱人发现了他们的阴谋。

“但很少有人听信，而那些听信的人则被灭口。我们被迫进入这些休眠舱，被投入虚空，如同之前许多人一样，被抛弃了。”§!

休眠舱密封舱室中的文件已被发现。
descriptions.en:
[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]'s account was recorded in full during [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer] recovery:

§H"My parents knew that [event_target:star_crossed_empire.GetName] was on the verge of awakening. Desperate to secure its favor, they struck a bargain. A quarter of our population was offered in exchange for power. My beloved and I uncovered their design.

"But few listened, and those who did were silenced. We were forced into these pods and cast into the void, discarded, as so many others had been before us."§!

Documentation from the pod's sealed compartments has been uncovered.

label.zh: 我们找到了你爱人的留言。
label.en: We found a message from your beloved.

descriptions.zh:
[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]在[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer]康复期间，完整地记录了他的陈述：

§H“我并非因我所做之事而被流放。我是因我所爱之人而被流放。

“我们的人民正在交战。我们已交战了数代。在我们人民眼中，我们的结合是一种无法被忽视的逾矩。我们拒绝分开，相信我们的结合或许能展示和平的价值。

“我们被迫进入这些休眠舱，被投入无尽的虚空。但我们的爱无法被割裂。”§!

在该休眠舱中发现了两位流亡者之间的私人通信。阅读它们令人深受鼓舞。
descriptions.en:
[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]'s account was recorded in full during [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer] recovery:

§H"I was not exiled for what I had done. I was exiled for who I loved.

"Our people were at war. We had been, for generations. In the eyes of our people, our bond was a transgression, one that could not be ignored. We refused to part, believing that our bond might demonstrate the value of peace.

"We were forced into these pods and cast into the relentless void. But our love could not be sundered."§!

Private correspondence between the two exiles was found in the pod. Reading it was inspiring.

label.zh: 我们找到了你爱人的留言。
label.en: We found a message from your beloved.

descriptions.zh:
[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]的自述在[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer]康复期间被完整记录下来：

§H“它最初只是思绪边缘的一个存在。后来我听到了声音。低语声一直跟着我，随着时间的推移变得越来越清晰，说的是一些零碎的词句。我的人民害怕我变成了什么样子，但我的爱人一直在我身边。

“我们一起被迫进入这个逃生舱，被抛入虚空，在任何可能触及我心智的东西扩散之前就被移走了。即使现在，我仍然能听到它。低语着。”§!

逃生舱的传感器日志揭示了大量有趣的数据。
descriptions.en:
[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]'s account was recorded in full during [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer] recovery:

§H"It began as a presence at the edge of thought. Then I heard the voice. The whispers followed me, growing clearer with time, speaking in fragments. My people feared what I had become, but my beloved stayed by my side.

"Together, we were forced into this pod and cast into the void, removed before whatever had touched my mind could spread. Even now, I still hear it. Whispering."§!

The pod's sensor logs have revealed an intriguing amount of data.

label.zh: 我们找到了你爱人的留言。
label.en: We found a message from your beloved.

descriptions.zh:
[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]的状况迅速恶化。就在其临终前不久，我们解密了伴侣舱发出的加密信息。信息内容如下：

§H“我的挚爱，

如果你听到这段话，那么命运对你比对我更仁慈。请知道，即使在虚空中，我也从未孤单，我始终与你同在。”§!

信息结束后不久，[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]的生命体征停止了。自从苏醒以来，[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer]的表情第一次如此平静。
descriptions.en:
[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]'s condition deteriorated rapidly. Shortly before their passing, we decrypted the sealed message from the companion pod. The transmission reads:

§H"My dearest,

"If you hear this, then fate has been kinder to you than it was to me. Know that, even in the void, I was never alone, I carried you with me, always."§!

Moments after the message concluded, [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]'s vital signs ceased. For the first time since awakening, [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer] expression was at peace.

tooltips.zh: 他们的最终证词为我们提供了关于[event_target:star_crossed_empire.GetName]的宝贵情报。
tooltips.en: Their final testimony has given us valuable intelligence on [event_target:star_crossed_empire.GetName].
